speaker: generic_agent
content: The business goal is to maximize total revenue from selling fixed-composition promotional packages A and B. Package A uses 1 shirt and 2 pairs of pants and sells for £30; Package B uses 3 shirts and 1 pair of pants and sells for £50. Available inventory is 200 shirts and 100 pairs of pants. Minimum sales requirements are 20 A packages and 10 B packages, and these are hard requirements. There is no upper limit on total packages beyond inventory, no salvage value or disposal cost for leftover inventory, and A and B are sold independently. The only decision is how many of each package to sell. Remaining minor assumption: package compositions and prices are fixed as given.
